title: Satsuma resource links
description: Per-nation car resources rendered in the 'Useful Resources' panel on the home page. Referenced from resources.json via a relative $schema path, so editors validate and autocomplete that file as you type.

$schema.description: Editor hint only. Not read by the app.

^[a-z]{2,3}-([A-Z][A-Z]+|[0-9]{3})$.description: BCP-47 locale key in the form produced by localeKey() in resources.ts: lowercase language, then a title-cased region.

name.description: Text shown on the link. The only user-visible string here, so translate it for the locale.

url.description: Where the link goes. https only — one of these opens a third-party site.

icon.description: Absolute https URL, or a path under /public such as /icons/foo.svg.
